text: The Irish economy has remained resilient and is projected to grow at a slower but still robust pace. Modified domestic demand growth is projected to moderate from almost 5 percent in 2025 to about 2½ percent in 2026–27, while headline inflation is projected to rise to about 3½ percent in 2026 and return to 2 percent around 2028. The outlook is subject to elevated uncertainty, with downside risks to growth and upside risks to inflation. Staff recommends a broadly neutral fiscal stance, MTFSP budget guidance, and ongoing CBI vigilance.
